title: Pipeline Extended 3-Post Grab Bar, 63-Inch Wall Mount ADA Compliant Iron Pipe Bathroom Grab Bar, Allied Brass
body_html:
Create a safer, more accessible bathroom without giving up industrial style—backed by a limited lifetime warranty. The Pipeline extended 3-post grab bar adds secure support where you need it most, with a third center bracket for enhanced stability.

  • Feel steadier stepping in and out of the shower or tub with a long 63-inch reach
  • Choose an industrial, pipe-style look that fits loft-inspired bathrooms and modern spaces
  • Rely on added stability from the 3-post mounting design with a third center bracket
  • Support daily routines with a 250 lb weight capacity and ADA compliant design
  • Keep the finish looking clean with a durable powder coat designed for corrosion-free, rust-free performance

Complete the look: Coordinate with matching pipeline pieces for a cohesive set of industrial bathroom hardware and pipe-style accessories from the Pipeline collection.
